findings.detail: Generic marker-only source assertions do not distinguish real backend execution from host fallback. Add backend-specific launcher/guard/flag assertions and remove copied unused imports.
Target-selection helper extraction should explicitly identify mechanically moved behavior and test explicit override/fallback paths rather than py_compile alone.
Use backend-specific route/compiler/guard examples instead of identical generic adapter descriptions.
The memory backend stages must add tests invoking numeric_memory.source/numeric_launcher; current declared adapter tests only generate stdout code and do not exercise added behavior.
Python execution created __pycache__ inside stage files/. Remove caches before assembly or exclude them explicitly.
Driver error recommends --resource-presentation before the resource stage introduces that option.

findings.status: addressed; benchmark-primitives now exports explicit compiler and verify-mode execution argv
findings.detail: A g++ string test command is omitted by assembly argv extraction, and benchmark sources are not test_*.cpp capabilities. Convert stage smoke compilation/execution to explicit argv arrays so this intermediate builds before publication.

assessment: Capability boundaries are coherent. Process byte capture, independent host oracle, immutable snapshots, negative diagnostics and batch isolation each support one reviewer decision. Registry discovers only present feature fixtures/adapters; handwritten templates stay visible. No dependency blocker found in current sources. Numeric host records, separate memory launchers, benchmark primitives, verified timing driver and compile-only resource reporting each form coherent follow-on decisions. Numeric template is conventionally formatted handwritten source and receives a runner-input hash. Final source review has no remaining scope/readability blocker. Runtime/build readiness remains contingent on the assembled-prefix validation run.
validation_limitations: No hardware or duplicate compiler run. Root validates actual assembled intermediate commits; portable adapter source checks do not establish runtime support.
resolution: Inspected concrete CUDA numeric allocation/copy/kernel/synchronization tests, mocked architecture override/query/fallback tests, removed future benchmark option advice and absence of __pycache__ in exports. Tooling owner reports 45 final Python tests passing; root retains actual intermediate execution evidence.
